violations.description: CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored not covered in freezer. Choco Bannana's in basket inside of reach in freezer. They are not contained or covered to protect from contamination. Food noted not properly labeled. Frozen chickens in another reach in freezer not properly labeled with original identifying information.

FOOD SOURCE (4 pts): Home prepared food noted being used in the establishment. Observed frozen chocolate covered bananas being produced in the facility without a food service license or proper food prep areas.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted being stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and in main grocery area. Observed whole peanuts stored in a burlap bag on the floor in main grocery area and a case of lettuce in the walk in cooler.
